findings.problem: Mobile renders "How this works" as 「使い方」 while web help.howThisWorks and the using-help guide (s2.b0 **使い方ガイド**) say 「使い方ガイド」. 「使い方」 is also what web help.kindHowTo ("How to") uses, so the same word would name two different things. Used as AppBar title, tooltip and race_stop_sheet button; 6 full-width chars fits all three.
"Works on" is 「対応」 on web and 「対応環境」 on mobile. A bare 「対応」 as a <dt> above platform badges reads as "support/response"; 対応環境 is the idiomatic label and matches the phone.
「Stripe の連携が必要」 drifts from web help.requiresStripeConnected 「Stripe アカウントの接続が必要」 and from every guide (「主催者のStripeアカウントの接続」). Same badge on the same guide on two surfaces should read the same.
findings.fix: Stripe アカウントの接続が必要
